Hades 2 will be released later today, Sept. 25, as the game expands to new platforms for more players to enjoy.
Technically, this isn't a brand new launch, as Hades 2 has been in early access for a fair amount of time. Finally, we are approaching the day when version 1.0 launches on all platforms. 9am PDT (Sept. 25)
11am CDT (Sept. 25)
12pm EDT (Sept. 25)
5pm BST (Sept. 25)

entry.title: How to solve Level 11 of I’m Not a Robot and find Waldo
entry.summary:
Level 11 in I'm Not a Robot introduces the first picture-based challenge in the game, and you'll have to find Waldo.
While this sounds like an easy task, the actual puzzle is tough. The image is larger than it appears at first, and you'll need to zoom out to find Waldo. This guide will help you find him without much trouble.
How to locate Waldo in Level 11 in I'm Not a Robot
Level 11 opens with an image of a beach with thousands of people on it. There's an ocean and some structures on the beach. Trying to locate Waldo in this scene can be a nightmare.
First, zoom out to see the whole image.
Waldo is located on the beach, so you can ignore the ocean and all those people on it.
Next, look to the right side of your screen.
You'll notice a stall with a red and white colored shade on it.
Waldo is located to the left of the stall. Go to the third grid from the left of the store, and you'll find Waldo over there.
Screenshot by Destructoid
To select him, click on the two boxes marked on the screenshot above. Click on Verify, and you'll be taken to the next test. Locating Waldo is at Level 11, and there are 48 levels to complete. We have detailed solutions about what you have to do to crack each level and proceed to the next one.

entry.title: How to solve Level 39 of I’m Not a Robot
entry.summary:
Level 39 of I'm Not a Robot is intuitive. All you have to do is turn on your webcam or phone camera and express emotions when prompted. What complicates this level is that it won't always work properly, so here's how to solve these issues and complete the level.
As soon as you enter level 39, you'll be prompted to turn on your webcam. Accept it, and if it all works fine, you'll see yourself on the screen. First, show a big smile to express happiness, which should fill up the bar at the top as you hold that smile. If that doesn't work, the game might be bugged, as it was in my case. When I tapped the refresh button on the bottom left of my image in the game and tried again, the happiness bar started filling up normally.
Then, repeat that process for sadness, anger, and surprise. If at any point the bar doesn't fill up, tap that refresh button in the game.
How to solve level 39 if your webcam doesn't work
When I first played this level, my PC webcam didn't start, even though I let the game access it. The game simply unlocked the Verify button a few seconds later and let me skip the level without doing any facial expressions. If your camera doesn't work, wait and see if you can click Verify to move on.
If you don't have a camera, see if this same skip is possible. Otherwise, try playing the game on your phone if you are on the PC.

entry.title: How to solve level 33 of I’m Not a Robot
entry.summary:
Level 33 of I'm Not a Robot will test how much you love capitalism—I mean, how many brand logos you know. Your goal in this level is to enter the text in the picture to solve it, but unlike level two, the "text" is a bunch of distorted brand logos.
It can get confusing: should you type the company name? And what company is that logo from?
This guide can only help you get to the answer, but not the exact answer for your case. That's because every player gets a different combination of logos on level 33, so it's a matter of understanding how to solve it on your own, and that's how I can help you.
Tips to beat level 33 in I'm Not a Robot
Each symbol is a company logo.
Every symbol looks like a letter, and that letter is usually the first letter of the company's name.
Consider each logo as a letter you have to type in. For example, if the first logo you see is Honda's, type an H.
You can do this intuitively even if you don't know the company's name. If the logo looks like a specific letter, type that letter in.
Repeat for every letter until you have a five-letter answer.
Make sure all letters are capitalized and have no spaces between them.
There's a refresh button on the bottom right of the picture that you can click to change the logos if you don't recognize one.

Some of these logos are easy to recognize. Screenshot by Destructoid.

entry.title: USN-7762-1: pip vulnerabilities
entry.summary:
Dennis Brinkrolf and Tobias Funke discovered that Requests incorrectly leaked Proxy-Authorization headers. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information. This update addresses the issue in the Requests module bundled into pip in Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. (CVE-2023-32681)
It was discovered that urllib3 didn't strip HTTP body on status code 303 redirects under certain circumstances. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information. This update addresses the issue in the urllib3 module bundled into pip in Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. (CVE-2023-45803)
Guido Vranken discovered that idna did not properly manage certain inputs, which could lead to significant resource consumption. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service. This update addresses the issue in the idna module bundled into pip in Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. (CVE-2024-3651)
Juho Forsén discovered that Requests did not correctly parse URLs. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to leak sensitive information. This update addresses the issue in the Requests module bundled into pip in Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 25.04. (CVE-2024-47081)

entry.title: How to get Three Segment form Dudunsparce in Pokémon Go
entry.summary:
After skipping a few events, Dudunsparce has finally joined Pokémon Go, and with it, its rare Three Segment evolution form is also making an appearance. But the chances of getting it are pretty slim.
For those who are clueless on what I am talking about, when you evolve Dunsparce into Dudunsparce in the Pokémon games, there is a slim chance that it'll have a three-sphere-shaped body over its regular two-sphere shape. This form is known as Three Segment, and is very rare, with that rarity crossing over to the mobile games.
So how does it work?
What are the chances of getting the Three Segment form of Dudunsparce in Pokémon Go?
Firstly, to evolve a Dunsparce into Dudunsparce, you need to use 50 Dunsparce candy. It's pretty simple, and there is no extra adventure effect to worry about, so you won't need to do anything extra on your quest to get a Three Segment form.
When you evolve Dunspace, it has a 1/100 chance of evolving into the Three Segment form, so for every evolution you do, those odds are rolled, and you won't know if you got it until the evolution ends and you see your new Pokémon.
These odds are the same for the Maushold line, which also has a 1/100 chance of evolving into the Family of Three evolution instead of its usual Family of Four form. These two Pokémon are unique in having these evolutions in-game.
If you want to try and get a Shiny Three Segment form, then you need to hope you either have a box full of the Shiny Pokémon, or you have incredible luck to find one. Thankfully, during the week of release, Dunsparce is having an increased spawn rate as well as an increased Shiny Rate, so maybe if you are lucky, you will find the Three Segment form sooner rather than later.

entry.summary: The battle over a $1 billion piracy judgment against internet provider Cox Communications has reached the Supreme Court, where the company receives broad support.
